parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =text ~ "{{ $json.keyword }}" AND updated >= "{{ $json.sinceDate }}" ORDER BY updated DESC

parameters.name: cql
parameters.value: text ~ "{{ $json.keyword }}" AND lastModified >= "{{ $json.sinceDate }}" ORDER BY lastModified DESC

parameters.name: fields
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ project: { key: $env.JIRA_PROJECT_KEY }, summary: 'Weekly Intelligence Report — ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE'), description: { type: 'doc', version: 1, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: $json.meetingNotes.slice(0, 2000) }] }] }, issuetype: { name: 'Task' }, labels: ['intelligence-report', 'automated'] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Report generated successfully', title: $('📄 Build Final Report').first().json.title, keywords: $('📄 Build Final Report').first().json.totalSummary.keywords }) }}
